description:
About the Scholarship

EDISS trains software engineers to build reliable, data-intensive intelligent systems, coordinated by Åbo Akademi University with partners in Spain, Italy and Sweden. The last intake accepted applications from 3 November 2025 to 8 January 2026 (15:00 Helsinki time), and the 2027 scholarship round is expected to follow the same pattern.

OpportunityEDISS – Erasmus Mundus Master in Engineering of Data-Intensive Intelligent Software Systems
HostEDISS Consortium (Åbo Akademi University)
LocationTurku (multi-country mobility), Finland
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€35,000
Application Deadline8 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EDISS trains software engineers to build reliable, data-intensive intelligent systems, coordinated by Åbo Akademi University with partners in Spain, Italy and Sweden. The last intake accepted applications from 3 November 2025 to 8 January 2026 (15:00 Helsinki time), and the 2027 scholarship round is expected to follow the same pattern.

Programme Highlights

  • First-year core in data science, then specialisations in industrial ML, computer vision or model-driven ML
  • Scholarship packages from EUR 35,000 to 49,000 over two years
  • Dedicated scholarship places for Western Balkans applicants
  • Strong employability in cloud, ML-platform and data-engineering roles

Who Should Apply

Computer science and software engineering graduates (or close equivalents) with programming and algorithms fundamentals. English proficiency evidence per the consortium's requirements.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships worth EUR 35,000-49,000 per student across the two years, with reserved places for Western Balkans applicants.

Deadline and How to Apply

Applications run through the EDISS portal; watch for the November 2026 opening and plan to submit before the early-January cut-off. Key deadline information: 8 January 2027 (15:00 Helsinki time, expected — mirrors the 2026 round; scholarship applications open in November 2026).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EDISS Consortium (Åbo Akademi University)

The EDISS consortium is coordinated by Åbo Akademi University and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in the Engineering of Data-Intensive Intelligent Software Systems with partner universities in Spain, Italy and Sweden.

Official website: https://www.master-ediss.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 8 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
